behaviors: Implement settings and model-runtime integration, including ResolveModel, LoadSettings and SaveSettings from API.go.txt. Caller overrides > project settings > global settings. Recursively merge JSON objects, preserve false/zero/null and unknown keys; arrays replace rather than concatenate. Missing files are empty settings, malformed existing files are errors. Save atomically with private permissions. Never execute shell snippets from credentials/config by default. ResolveModel copies caller data, preserves provider/API/base URL/headers/compatibility/context and output capacity, validates positive explicit limits within model capacity, and does not hardcode 128K/4096. Preserve thinking capabilities and use an injected APIKey callback per provider. Reuse Pith catalog/auth/provider abstractions for real requests; optional OAuth token refresh uses existing auth code through an explicit caller adapter, not browser interaction. No credentials in events, logs, maps or session files. Additional candidate tests: nested null values, absent files, save interruption, invalid model overrides, concurrent independent configuration, empty/failed credential callback. Go extensions and custom models must not require shared process-wide mutation.

Implement SessionManager with memory-only mode when path is empty and append-only durable file mode otherwise. Each message, compaction, model/thinking change and custom record has a unique ID and parent; preserve unknown JSON fields/payloads. Entries lists all entries, Context lists the active root-to-leaf branch, Branch changes the leaf durably without deleting siblings. Empty id branches to the root. Unknown IDs and cycles fail without mutation. Thread-safe append and immutable returned snapshots are required. Opening malformed complete records must fail visibly; document the crash-tail recovery policy, never silently erase a valid prefix. Check write/close errors and use mode 0600. Existing Pith JSONL/session storage can be adapted; do not rewrite existing public types. This new public API need not read every historical Pi JSONL version; explicitly document supported file version and provide rejection for unsupported formats. Candidate tests must cover reopen, leaf persistence without a subsequent append, empty sessions, branch isolation, unknown metadata, truncated records, disk failure and racing snapshots/appends. AgentSession will persist and reconstruct its model/thinking/message/compaction context using this manager.

Implement explicit ResourceOptions discovery: supplied Cwd/AgentDir and paths only; do not silently use ~/.pi. Discover project AGENTS.md (and caller ContextFiles), SKILL.md frontmatter and prompt template .md files; reuse Pith resources and existing pure-Go YAML/frontmatter code. Assemble system prompt, append prompts and context instructions with source attribution. Skill descriptions belong in discovery; skill body remains available for explicit loading, not an instruction to execute at discovery. Expand $1, $2 and $ARGUMENTS with predictable missing/extra-argument handling. Directory traversal must avoid symlink loops and report duplicate skill/template names and malformed frontmatter through errors/diagnostics. Project trust is explicit through host-supplied paths; loading never runs code, installs packages or sends network requests. Repeated LoadResources reflects edits. Candidate tests: duplicate precedence, missing path diagnostics, recursive skills, explicit empty system prompt, binary/unreadable resources, no execution of fenced commands. Keep hook/skill and settings inputs injectable for desktop and server hosts.

Implement ToolDefinition/ToolRegistry/Hooks and bridge them to existing Pith AgentTool types. Reuse read/write/edit/bash from packages/agent/harness/tools and environment; adapt grep/find/ls from coding-agent without requiring bundled ripgrep/node binaries (Go implementation or explicitly supplied backend). Default active tools are read/write/edit/bash plus custom Go tools; nil allow is default, explicit empty allow disables all, deny applies last. Validate JSON Schema before Execute, reject duplicate names and unknown activation, never invoke inactive tools. Before hook runs for every valid executable call and may deny; After runs on executed results and can transform them. Run hooks outside internal locks. Context cancellation must reach process groups/children, filesystem operations where supported and custom callbacks. Register and SetActive must not race execution and must surface model-visible declarations on the next request. Preserve result images/details/error markers. Search and read results must be bounded with explicit truncation metadata, never silently clip. File mutation queue must serialize edits to the same path. Candidate tests must cover all seven tools, exact edit mismatch, cwd, symlink handling, cancellation during bash, tool errors, duplicate registration, allow/deny precedence and before/after transformations. These are execution hooks, not an OS sandbox.

Implement CreateAgentSession and AgentSession using Pith Agent/agent-loop rather than sdk.Run's small standalone loop. Assemble model/options, resources, tools, configuration and durable session manager. Prompt is synchronous until completion; only one run per session, concurrent Prompt fails immediately. Independent sessions may run concurrently. Preserve user/assistant/tool messages including thinking, images and provider metadata. Custom tools are advertised and results pair with exact call IDs. Structured Subscribe returns idempotent unsubscribe; publish agent_start/end, message_start/update/end, tool_execution_start/update/end, turn_start/end events in causal order. Listeners can inspect snapshots/unsubscribe without lock deadlock. Messages and RunResult snapshots are detached from mutable state. Return turns, stop reason and actual usage; do not fabricate cost. SetModel/SetActiveTools apply safely between requests; reject invalid changes. Support Steer and FollowUp during a run and queue semantics from source. Cancel/Abort return errors and propagate to streams/tools; Close unsubscribes and releases resources without closing a caller-owned manager. Save coherent turns and restore without replaying successful side effects. Tests must cover tool failure recovery, model changes, queue ordering, no cross-session global state, restart after completed turn, unknown tools and listener cleanup.

Complete long-running lifecycle behavior in AgentSession. No default max turn or wall-clock cap. Explicit MaxTurns > 0 is enforced with a clear error and persisted context. A length-truncated assistant response must NEVER execute its tool calls (even parseable ones); preserve safe history and request continuation until a non-length response or caller cancellation. RetryAttempts counts extra requests after transient 429/5xx/connection failures, with cancellable backoff; default is three retries, zero means default, negative disables. Never retry auth/invalid request failures or replay completed tool effects. Emit retry events and preserve request diagnostics without secrets. Handle terminal errors and cancellation distinctly. Before overflowing model context, compact while preserving recent complete tool-call/result pairs. Use caller Summarize when present; otherwise reuse Pith compaction with the configured provider. Reserve model output capacity, do not mutate model limits. CompactReserveTokens overrides reserve for tests; KeepRecentMessages retains at least that many messages but never splits pairs. Persist compaction summary/checkpoint so reopen restores compacted history. Failed/cancelled summarization leaves original history intact. Explicit Compact works while idle; concurrent calls fail clearly. Tests must include retry exhaustion, nonretryable errors, real cancellation during provider/tool/backoff, no partial arguments, auto/manual compaction, failed summary rollback, cancellation then next Prompt, steering/follow-up and clean Close.

Finish the stable public embedded SDK and English integration guide. Compile/run examples for minimal prompt, custom model/key callback, custom verification tool/hooks, event subscription, durable resume/branch, skills/templates, and HTTP/SSE embedding with request cancellation and per-user session isolation. Examples use local fake streams by default or explicit environment configuration for live providers; no live model calls during go test. Do not present a sample web handler as a production auth system. Document public package, lifecycle ownership, concurrency, supported providers via existing Pith AI registry, cancellation, limits, privacy, failures and exclusions. Real HTTP Chat Completions/tool loop must pass local httptest acceptance without injecting StreamFn. Include a Portsmith-style custom verify_candidate tool that reports failure then allows repair in the same conversation. Complete all seven source_map files, not merely package-level mapping: source/upstream/goPackage/goSymbol/goFile/reason (optional disposition excluded with a concrete scope reason). Use real exported top-level declarations or type aliases, no marker-only exports. Files with mixed TUI/Go adaptation must explain differences. No selected source may be entirely marked excluded. Cross-compile CGO_ENABLED=0 on darwin/arm64, linux/amd64 and windows/amd64; run no-CGO tests, vet, examples and race checks. Freeze an honest compatibility table; tests do not prove all Pi parity. Do not modify existing CLI or old sdk.Run in this increment; document migration to the new embedded entry point.
